_about: Estimated chance of winning a FUNDED place this cycle, out of 10, for Batch 1 routes. Judgement, not a statistic: based on what the board knows (fresh MBBS, no publications or work experience, internship until late 2027, marks and class rank unknown) plus published award numbers where they exist. Factors are scored 0-3: eligibility (does he clearly qualify), competition (3 = less crowded), profile (how well a no-research MBBS matches who they pick), timing (does the start date fit the internship).

imperial-pres.why: About 50 awards across all of Imperial, and you need a supervisor's agreement before applying. Round 1 has closed; round 2 closes 11 Jan 2027.
raise: A supervisor who agrees to back you for round 2 (11 Jan 2027)
A first-class-equivalent MBBS result and class rank
Any research output from the internship year

oist-phd.why: Very competitive, research-led selection. Basic science rather than medicine, and OIST doesn't say an MBBS qualifies.
raise: Written confirmation that an MBBS is accepted
A unit with space that matches computational or neuroscience interests
Some coding or lab experience

sanger-phd.why: At least 12 places worldwide, and genomics and coding skills carry the selection.
raise: Python or R and basic statistics in your CV
A genomic-epidemiology question in your statement
An answer from Sanger on a later start

eth-esop.why: About 60 awards; you need roughly the top 10% of your class and a strong thesis pre-proposal.
raise: A class-rank certificate showing top 10%
A convincing quantitative thesis pre-proposal
A September 2028 start instead

yenching.why: Any degree qualifies and the cohort is large for a fellowship, but it's still elite. A health-policy proposal is your angle.
raise: A sharp research statement on China's health system or global health diplomacy
IELTS 7.0+ sent directly to the Academy
Letters from professors in your intended field

clarendon.why: You need an Oxford offer first, then Clarendon picks only the very top applicants. The October 2027 start clashes.
raise: Top marks and class rank
Research output before the December deadline
Applying in the 2028 cycle when you can arrive

emjm-neurasmus.why: About 20 places from 800+ applicants (roughly 1 in 40), and lab or neuroscience experience helps.
raise: Clinical neurology exposure or a neuro research project
Strong motivation letter tied to neuroscience
Confirming a later start is possible

hkpfs.why: Eligibility and timing are excellent (deferral to Jan 2028), but about 400 fellowships worldwide go mostly to people with publications.
raise: A supervisor at HKU or CUHK who backs your proposal
A focused epidemiology research proposal
Even one paper or abstract from the internship

jhu-phd.why: One of the most competitive epidemiology PhDs anywhere; most admits have a master's or research record, and the work-experience line is unresolved.
raise: A yes from Hopkins on whether the internship counts
A master's or 1–2 years of research first
Strong quantitative evidence (statistics, coding)

emory-phd.why: 200+ applications for 10–14 places (about 1 in 17), and admits often hold advanced degrees.
raise: Research experience and a publication
A faculty member whose work matches yours
Applying after a research year

singa.why: Supervisor-led selection in science and engineering; the January 2028 intake fits your timing well.
raise: A supervisor at A*STAR, NUS or NTU who wants you
A biomedical or data-science project angle
Targeting the 1 June 2027 round

mps.why: Multi-stage selection that favours research and computational backgrounds; the fall 2027 start clashes.
raise: Computational skills for the Biomedical AI School
A clear research interest matched to a faculty member
Asking about a later start

euhem.why: There is no scholarship, so the chance of a funded place is zero. Admission alone would be realistic.
raise: Nothing changes the funding; choose a funded Erasmus Mundus programme instead

gates.why: About 70 full-cost awards worldwide, after first winning a Cambridge place; the October 2027 start clashes.
raise: Top academic standing
Evidence of leadership and service in public health
Applying when you can actually start

cw-shared.why: Less crowded than Chevening or Gates and designed for people like you, but the 2:1 mapping and the start date are open.
raise: Confirmation that your MBBS meets the 2:1 standard
An approved course with a university that allows a later start
A development-impact case for Bangladesh

emjm-noha.why: Scholarship applicants must have completed their degree by 15 Dec 2026, which may rule you out this year. About 16 scholarships with a 10% nationality cap.
raise: NOHA confirming your MBBS counts as completed
Humanitarian or community-health experience in the CV

unc-phd.why: Admission is possible, but funding isn't guaranteed for international students, so a funded place is the hard part.
raise: A named faculty mentor with grant money for you
Quantitative skills on paper

mbzuai.why: A medical degree may not count as STEM, and MSc places are fee-paying by default; only the PhD route is funded.
raise: Admissions confirming an MBBS is eligible
75%+ on the screening exam
Python and machine-learning coursework

au-sydney.why: Direct MBBS-to-PhD entry is case by case and needs a supervisor; 2027 research periods clash with your internship.
raise: A supervisor who backs a direct PhD application
One publication or research output
Targeting a 2028 research period

emjm-phid.why: Health degrees accepted and no experience minimum, but Erasmus scholarships are limited and the 2027 start clashes.
raise: IELTS writing at 6.5 or above
Disaster or outbreak-response experience from the internship
Agreement on a later start, or the 2028 cycle

ntu-rss.why: The January 2028 intake fits your timing, but you need a supervisor and some research experience for the clinician route.
raise: An LKCMedicine supervisor's agreement
Research experience on the CV
Applying in the 1–30 June 2027 window

kaust.why: Funding is automatic if admitted, but programmes are science and data only, and August 2027 is too early.
raise: A bioscience or data-science programme that accepts an MBBS
Evidence of quantitative skills
Deferral to 2028

emjm-imim.why: Medicine is a named eligible field and the translational focus suits an MBBS, but scholarships are limited.
raise: Research experience, even small
A sharp translational-research motivation
Confirming a later start

emory-mph.why: Internationals are considered automatically for merit awards (50-100% of tuition), but only tuition is covered, and a full-tuition award is the hard part. The score measures a funded place that is affordable.
raise: A file SOPHAS-verified well before 5 Jan
Strong marks and a clear public-health story
A plan for REAL and paid US research work alongside

eiffel.why: Only institutions can nominate, and most internal deadlines passed in Oct–Nov 2026.
raise: Nomination through IDOH or another programme still open
Planning for the 2028 round from September 2027

emjm-humres.why: A health degree fits well and it's free to apply, but there are only 15 scholarships and experience is 20% of the score.
raise: Community or outbreak work from the internship
A strong motivation statement
Asking about a later start

emjm-eph.why: Medical graduates accepted and no experience required; competition for scholarships is strong.
raise: A motivation letter tied to epidemiology and data
Interview preparation for 18 Feb
Choosing the right track and city

ista-phd.why: MBBS eligibility isn't stated, selection is very competitive, and the fixed 15 Sep 2027 start rules out this year.
raise: Confirmation that an MBBS qualifies
Computational or lab experience
Applying for the 2028 intake

csc.why: Bangladesh is eligible through two routes and university places are relatively accessible, but the 2027 call isn't out yet.
raise: Two target universities with English-taught public health
Documents ready before the December notice
Applying through both the embassy and a university

emjm-idoh.why: A direct interest match with a straightforward application, but limited scholarship seats.
raise: An infectious-disease angle from your internship
A strong motivation letter
Asking about a later start

hartford-srf.why: IMGs are encouraged and J-1 sponsorship exists, but pay isn't stated, research experience is preferred and the field is surgery.
raise: Confirmation the post is paid
Any research output
A January 2028 cycle start

reading-intl-phd.why: Each School nominates just one candidate, and there's no health track.
raise: A Reading supervisor whose project matches your interests

hung.why: Bangladesh is a Sending Partner with no experience rule; the dual nomination process is the main hurdle.
raise: Applying to both Tempus and the Sending Partner
A public health programme with space
Savings to cover the small stipend

mastermind.why: Each university nominates up to 20 people, but health-programme eligibility is unclear and the terms are under review.
raise: Confirmation that a health master's qualifies
Strong marks (top of class)

columbia-mph.why: Admission is realistic, but the money is partial and small next to New York costs.
raise: A large named award
Adding it cheaply to an existing SOPHAS application

si.why: You need about 3,000 hours of paid work before February 2027, and the internship doesn't count.
raise: About 18 months of post-internship work, then reapply

emjm-live.why: Clinicians are explicitly welcomed; scholarships are limited and some are partial.
raise: A vaccinology or infection-control angle
IELTS 6.5 or above
Asking about a later start

emjm-spacemed.why: A medical degree is the core background, but there are only about 20 scholarships and degree-completion timing is open.
raise: SpaceMed confirming how an internship-pending MBBS counts
Top grades (40% of the score)
A sharp motivation video

unimelb-mdhs.why: Automatic scholarship consideration, but research experience is usually expected and 2027 offers must start by 31 Oct.
raise: A supervisor at MDHS
One research output
Applying for a 2028 start

nz-waikato.why: Four rounds a year help timing, but you need an Offer of Place and MBBS-to-PhD entry is unclear.
raise: A supervisor's invitation
Confirmation an MBBS gives PhD entry

usra.why: Score measures the chance of landing a paid US research post for a start after the internship. Posts are real and rolling, but you have no publications and the MBBS must be conferred first.
raise: Turn one internship project into a poster, abstract or case report
Build a list of 20-30 labs and start emailing in May-July 2027
Get a strong letter from a consultant who has supervised research

mayo-rf.why: Score measures the chance of landing a paid Mayo post. You qualify on paper once the MBBS is conferred, but each opening draws many applicants with publications.
raise: Set Mayo job alerts now and read the person specifications
Get a first-author abstract or paper out of your thesis data
Write to the principal investigator as well as applying on the portal

ecfmg-j1rs.why: This is not an award. Score measures the chance you can actually complete the sponsorship step this cycle: fees are small against your budget, but it needs a conferred MBBS and a host offer first.
raise: Secure a written offer from a US host
Ask each host early whether they sponsor directly or via ECFMG
Keep about $750 in cash set aside for year one

ecfmg.why: This is not an award. Score measures the chance you can complete the Step 1 and certification groundwork this cycle on your budget: fees are affordable and fully in your control, but the internship leaves little study time.
raise: Check your school's ECFMG sponsor note on wdoms.org this week
Book Step 1 only after a timed practice assessment
Block out fixed weekly study hours during the internship

maastricht-gh.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place. About 2% of applicants win, you need 75%+ marks that are not yet known, and a Sept 2027 start clashes with the internship.
raise: Get your marks converted and a class-rank letter now
Resolve the MBBS-as-bachelor's and GRE question with admissions
Submit the full file well before 10 Dec 2026

maastricht-epi.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place. About 2% of applicants win, you need 75%+ marks, the full-time variant's scholarship eligibility is unconfirmed, and Sept 2027 clashes with the internship.
raise: Ask UM to confirm full-time Epidemiology is scholarship-eligible
Get your marks converted and a class-rank letter
Submit the full file well before 10 Dec 2026

nih-vf.why: Score measures the chance of a paid NIH fellowship. It is very competitive, you have no research record, and it is unconfirmed that your MBBS meets the doctoral requirement.
raise: Ask NIH's Division of International Services to confirm MBBS eligibility
Build a short research record from the internship
Target labs whose recent papers match your epidemiology interests

emjm-all.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place somewhere in the catalogue this cycle. Up to three applications improve the odds, but scholarship places are scarce and a Sept 2027 start clashes with the internship.
raise: Shortlist three programmes that state they accept medicine
Get an English-medium-of-instruction certificate and attested transcripts early
Write a motivation letter that ties each programme to your public health aim

usphd.why: Score measures the chance of a funded US PhD place this cycle. An MBBS is usually accepted, but admissions are very competitive, you have no research record and the 1 Dec deadlines are four weeks away.
raise: Start with JHU Epidemiology (no GRE) and request the SOPHAS fee waiver
Line up letters from supervisors who know your work
Book IELTS or TOEFL now

kh.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place this cycle. The 2027 cohort closed on 6 Oct 2026, so there is no live window; the next realistic cycle is the 2028 cohort.
raise: Check the KHS site around June 2027
Build leadership and research evidence during 2027
Look at Stanford programmes you would apply to for the 2028 cohort

emjm-hygieia.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place. MBBS is explicitly eligible and the subject fits, but only 25 places exist, the 2027 deadline is unpublished and Sept 2027 clashes with the internship.
raise: Book IELTS or TOEFL now
Check hygieiamaster.eu regularly for the 2027 dates
Prepare a motivation letter linking prevention and lifespan health to your internship

lshtm-fund.why: Score measures the chance of the single funded place. Only one award a year, the 2027-28 round is unannounced, and a 2027 start clashes with the internship.
raise: Keep transcripts, degree certificate and references ready
Watch the LSHTM scholarships page for the 2027-28 advert
Plan for the 2028-29 round and a strong MSc Epidemiology application

mext.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place. You likely meet the age and degree rules and the April 2028 arrival fits, but selection runs through a national exam and interview.
raise: Write a research plan in public health or epidemiology by March 2027
Watch moedu.gov.bd in April 2027 for the advert
Start basic Japanese study

emjm-imagein.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place. Eligibility for an MBBS holder is unconfirmed, the fit to your interests is partial, and the Sept 2027 start clashes with the internship.
raise: Email the programme to confirm MBBS eligibility
Gather an English-medium-of-instruction certificate
Prepare the application before the 6 Jan 2027 opening

Only pursue if you want a bench-science pivot
Email the programme about MBBS fit before investing time

emjm-other-health.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place on one of these ten programmes. None is verified, several are poor fits for an MBBS holder, and Sept 2027 clashes with the internship.
raise: Check EMMaH and ECT+ One Health sites first
Confirm scholarship availability on each programme page
Email programmes that do not name medicine

mext-unirec.why: Score measures the chance of a funded doctoral place. A supervisor must already agree, the call normally runs only Nov-Dec, and the October 2027 start clashes with the internship.
raise: Email prospective supervisors at Hamamatsu this week
Ask whether a later start than October 2027 is possible
Prepare English proof at CEFR B2 across all four skills

gks.why: Score measures the chance of a funded place this cycle. You likely meet age and degree rules, but only seven Embassy places were offered for Bangladesh in 2026, marks are unknown, and the Sept 2027 start clashes.
raise: Ask your medical college how it can certify your marks and class rank
Check the 2027 guidelines in early February
Prepare a research plan in public health or epidemiology

daad-study.why: The Bangladesh window closed on 31 Aug 2026, so there is no live way in this cycle. The next call, for funding from Oct 2028, would fit your post-internship timeline better.
raise: Watch the DAAD database page each spring for the next Bangladesh deadline
Start collecting a German master's shortlist and IELTS or TestDaF plan
Build one research output during the internship year

it-dsu.why: DSU is a means-tested benefit claimed after you secure an Italian university place, not a competition, so the score is your chance of actually receiving the benefit. Calls for 2027/28 are not out until summer 2027 and you need admission first.
raise: Start the family income and asset papers for the ISEE parificato early
Pick the Italian master's and note its region's agency
Check that your degree level is allowed under that region's rules

bcs51.why: Applications closed on 25 Oct 2026, so you cannot enter this exam. Score 0 measures a paid government post this cycle; the 52nd regular BCS has no circular yet.
raise: Watch bpsc.gov.bd for the 52nd BCS circular
Keep your temporary BMDC registration paperwork ready
Check the age limit (21-32 on 1 September 2026) against future dates

turk.why: Free and fully funded, but the 2027 call is not announced, the health-graduate marks bar is high (board: at least 90%), and the start clashes with your internship. Score is the chance of a funded place this cycle.
raise: Check your MBBS marks against the stated threshold once the call is out
Prepare transcripts and referee letters before January
Confirm only on turkiyeburslari.gov.tr, never via agents

qatar.why: This is a licence, not an award, so the score is your chance of completing the step this cycle. Eligibility before the internship certificate (late 2027) is unconfirmed, and it needs an employer to approve the evaluation.
raise: Keep internship and BMDC papers clean and ready for verification
Ask Qatar-based contacts what DHP currently asks for fresh graduates
Do not pay agents; check fees inside the official portal

nus-sph.why: The Aug 2027 round closed on 1 Nov 2026 and a confirmed advisor is mandatory, so there is no live window. The Aug 2028 round (about 1 Nov 2027, not announced) is the real target.
raise: Start emailing SSHSPH faculty about advisor fit well before Oct 2027
Book IELTS (7.0 stated by the board) and consider the GRE
Produce a first paper or protocol during the internship

smle.why: A licensing step, so the score is your chance of completing it this cycle. Classification asks for the internship certificate, which you will not hold until late 2027, and fees and dates are unpublished.
raise: Plan DataFlow verification for the last months of internship
Confirm current classification rules inside Mumaris+ before paying anyone
Check whether your target employer wants a year of post-internship experience

plab.why: A licensing exam you can control, so the score is your chance of completing a PLAB step this cycle on your budget. The new prioritisation rules make UK training and some posts harder to win, but not the exam itself.
raise: Start the ECFMG EPIC verification early
Book IELTS or OET once your PLAB 1 date is chosen
Fund Manchester travel and a visitor visa for PLAB 2 within the 2-year window

cw.why: The 2027/28 round closed on 20 Oct 2026 and the Bangladesh nominating step ended earlier. No live window this cycle.
raise: Watch for the next UGC Bangladesh call (about Aug-Sep 2027, a board estimate)
Get a UK university offer first, as UGC asked for it
Prepare a development-impact statement around health systems

ireland.why: A licensing route, so the score is your chance of completing registration this cycle. You need the PRES route (or PLAB 2) and your internship papers, and registration timing before the internship ends is unconfirmed.
raise: Check the internship rotation record against the Council's rules
Consider PLAB as the cheaper route to a PRES exemption
Budget the €451 application and the PRES Level 3 fee of €1,500

euphd.why: Most posts ask for a recognised master's, so an MBBS alone is accepted only post by post. With no publications you start behind the pack, and a 3-4 year contract would replace the 2029 plan.
raise: Email the supervisor to ask in writing if an MBBS counts as a master's
Target German medical faculty posts that accept an MBBS
Get a first-author paper or protocol during the internship

amc.why: A licensing pathway you pay for, so the score is your chance of completing a step (EPIC verification, MCQ authorisation) this cycle. The MCQ can be sat early, but registration needs a verified internship and the route does not serve the 2029 plan.
raise: Only start if Australia is a real destination, not a hedge
Start ECFMG verification during the internship
Budget the three AMC fees plus travel for the clinical exam

edin-dcs.why: The PhD application is due 9 Nov 2026, six days away, there are only a few awards in the college, and you have no master's or papers. A Sept 2027 start also clashes with your internship.
raise: Email an Edinburgh supervisor this week if you still want to try
Aim for the 2028-29 round with a stronger paper record
Keep the 2 Feb 2027 scholarship deadline in mind only if admission is submitted

intlra.why: Paid research posts exist, but entry roles may ask for stats skills, papers or prior experience. The score is the chance of a paid post this cycle; you have no outputs yet.
raise: Learn R or Stata and show a small public analysis
Aim for one case report or audit during the internship
Apply to Sidra and HMC research assistant posts after the internship certificate

germany-app.why: A licensing route, so the score is your chance of completing a real step this cycle. You need B2 general German and then C1 medical German, plus the Kenntnisprüfung, so Approbation is a multi-year project.
raise: Start German now and aim for B2 before late 2027
Fix a target state and ask its authority for the exact checklist
Budget the blocked account of about €11,904 a year plus exam fees

goi-ies.why: Only 60 awards worldwide, no 2027 call yet, and you must hold an Irish university offer first. A Sept 2027 start also collides with the internship.
raise: Pick the Irish master's and apply for admission before the call opens
Plan for two referee letters ready in January
Budget the extra living costs the €10,000 will not cover

hbku-chls.why: The PhD needs a master's, so only the MS is realistic, and whether an MBBS counts is unconfirmed. Waivers are limited and an Aug 2027 start clashes with the internship.
raise: Email HBKU CHLS admissions on whether an MBBS counts for the MS
Check your marks against the 3.0 GPA line
Book IELTS 6.5 before the 1 Feb 2027 deadline if you go ahead

ukdtp.why: International places are capped at about 30% of an intake, UKRI covers only the Home fee, and Wellcome health-professional programmes target registered clinicians. You also have no research output yet.
raise: Look for programmes that top up the international fee
Contact programme managers directly before applying
Build a research record first and revisit for 2028

emjm-maia.why: Score is the chance of a funded place this cycle. The call is not open, the stated degree background is technical, and an MBBS is not named, so this is a very long shot.
raise: Email info@maiamaster.org and ask in writing whether an MBBS meets the admission criteria.
Only pursue it if you build a real coding or imaging project portfolio first.

de-msc.why: This is a self-funded degree, so the score is the chance you can actually apply, get in and afford it this cycle. Entry is plausible for a doctor, but the budget and a Match 2029 timetable make it a hard fit.
raise: Pick 2-3 English-taught programmes and read each one's own deadline and entry rules.
Price the full two years against your USD 30k before applying.
Decide your Step 1 timetable first, then choose a start date.

embl-phd.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. The Winter call is closed, the next one is unconfirmed, and a fresh MBBS with no lab record is far down the pool.
raise: Get a research master's or a paid research assistant job first.
Use EMBL's Shared Applicant Pool only if you later have a genuine lab background.

rtp.why: Score is the chance of a funded research-degree place this cycle. There is no single application and the entry bar is research-heavy, so it stays a long shot.
raise: Pick one or two named universities and read their own rounds.
Build a first paper or audit with a local research mentor before you write to supervisors.

au-anu.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. Round 1 is closed, Round 2 needs a supervisor and an August 2027 start, and you have no research record.
raise: Find a supervisor and ask about expression-of-interest rules now.
Get one co-authored paper or audit before the next round.

monash-mgs.why: Score is the chance of a funded research place this cycle. The round fits, but you need a supervisor invite and a research record you do not yet have.
raise: Email a Monash supervisor in public health or epidemiology.
Aim for the 31 Jul 2027 round and prepare a research proposal draft.

uae.why: Score is the chance you can complete this step this cycle. The GP title expects post-internship experience you do not have, so it is not open to you now.
raise: Complete internship and the post-internship experience the PQR asks for.
Re-check the unified PQR text before paying DataFlow.

nz-auckland.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. There is a live round, but entry from an MBBS is unclear and you lack research output.
raise: Ask the Medical and Health Sciences graduate office whether MBBS meets doctoral entry.
Line up a supervisor before the 1 Aug 2027 round.

vbc-phd.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. The autumn call is closed and the programme expects a master's and lab record.
raise: Gain research-master's level experience before applying.
Only reconsider if you leave the clinical-timeline plan.

nz-wellington.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. About 110 awards a year helps, but you lack a supervisor, a proposal and research output.
raise: Ask a Wellington supervisor whether MBBS plus a research plan is enough.
Target the 1 Jul 2027 round.

nz-otago.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. Rolling rounds help, but entry from an MBBS without research and a review of the scheme keep it a long shot.
raise: Re-read the official page and contact an Otago epidemiology supervisor.
Aim for the September or November 2027 round.

fogarty.why: Score is the chance of a funded fellowship this cycle. The 2027-28 deadlines are reported as passed and Bangladesh was not at the sites the board checked (neither confirmed on the Fogarty page), so only a later cycle is realistic.
raise: Check each consortium's site list in mid-2027.
Build a research link at a local partner institution.

nz-canterbury.why: Score is the chance of a funded PhD place this cycle. The May round fits your calendar, but MBBS entry is unconfirmed and you have no research record.

Line up a supervisor before 15 May 2027.

ngo-bd.why: Score is the chance of a paid post. Requirements vary by vacancy, and you are mid-internship with no field experience and many posts ask for it.
raise: Complete the internship and register with BMDC.
Do any short outbreak or camp-clinic volunteering for field credit.
Set ReliefWeb and BRAC alerts.

unicef-intern.why: Score is the chance of a paid placement. You qualify, but competition is wide and your internship delays the start.
raise: Prepare a UN-style CV and cover letter now.
Target Dhaka or Cox's Bazar health posts when they open.

who.why: Score is the chance of a placement. You are eligible now, but vacancies are scarce and the timing around your internship is awkward.

Confirm how WHO counts your completion date.

Ask the Dhaka office about remote or country-office posts.

Ask Gavi when a student-status rule is counted from.

Get a written answer on J-1 212(e) before paying
Cost out 24 months against your full USD 30,000

mgh-irf.why: The 16 Oct 2026 deadline has passed, so no award is possible this cycle, and year 1 is unfunded anyway.

Line up outside funding before any future application
Build a first paper or abstract in the meantime

Use a funded master's route for Germany instead

Only continue if you commit to ENT
Compare with a general epidemiology research post

Finish Step 1 before applying
Get one case report or abstract submitted

Apply to programmes with known assistantships, such as Hopkins by 1 Dec 2026 if you can be ready
Get WES course-by-course evaluation done early

Apply to two or three platforms and finish screening tests
Cap yourself at 10 to 15 hours a week

raise: Set a reminder for August 2027
Prepare an English test and referee letters early
Shortlist English-taught health programmes
